scenes.title: Уроки на рынке  (Market Lessons)
scenes.summary: Viktor takes Max along to the fish market to teach him how to identify fresh produce from vendors subtle expressions.

scenes.title: Возвращение на кухню  (Return to the Kitchen)
scenes.summary: Walking back from the market, Max and Viktor discuss their culinary standards and dismiss rumors about their rival restaurant.

scenes.title: Долг и меню  (Debt and Menu)
scenes.summary: Victoria demands that Viktor repay his outstanding debt or present a brand-new seasonal chef special by tomorrow.

scenes.title: Дисциплина в зале  (Discipline in the Hall)
scenes.summary: Victoria reprimands the waitstaff for flirting during working hours, before Max tries to invite her out for the evening.

scenes.title: Сезонное меню  (Seasonal menu)
scenes.summary: Chef Viktor announces a contest for a seasonal dish. The winner gets a bonus.

scenes.title: Двойное свидание  (Double date)
scenes.summary: Max brings Vika to a double date with Nastya and Kostya. Vika and Nastya argue and Vika leaves.

scenes.title: Неудачное знакомство  (An Unsuccessful Introduction)
scenes.summary: Max introduces his new girlfriend Victoria to his best friends, but the meeting starts off very awkwardly.

scenes.title: Странные друзья  (Strange Friends)
scenes.summary: Victoria complains about Max's strange friends, and they eventually leave feeling deeply offended.

scenes.title: Сезонное блюдо  (The Seasonal Dish)
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov tastes the kitchen team's submissions for the new seasonal menu and selects Senya's veal rolls with ham, leaving Fedya frustrated that his dish was not even tasted.

scenes.title: Котлеты со спаржей  (Chops with Asparagus)
scenes.summary: In the kitchen, a disappointed Fedya shows off his Breton lamb chops with asparagus after Chef Barinov walks away, while Senya proudly celebrates winning the seasonal menu contest.

scenes.title: День рождения Макса  (Max's Birthday)
scenes.summary: Looking for a way to reconcile his feuding friends and his girlfriend Sasha, Max suddenly remembers that tomorrow is his birthday, though he worries nobody will believe a last-minute invitation.

scenes.title: Хитрость и слайсер  (A Trick and a Slicer)
scenes.summary: Senya impresses Nagiyev with his tasty veal rolls and cleverly convinces him to buy a new slicer.

scenes.title: Два зала  (Two Dining Rooms)
scenes.summary: Visiting a rival restaurant, Chef Viktor Barinov makes sarcastic jokes about the establishment having two dining halls and air conditioning before asking the hostess for a table in the smoking section.

scenes.title: Подарок на день рождения  (A Birthday Gift)
scenes.summary: At Claude Monet, Kostya and Nastya warmly congratulate Max on his birthday and surprise him with a ticket to DJ Vanderoit's concert so the three friends can party together tonight.

scenes.title: Билет в клуб  (A Ticket to the Club)
scenes.summary: While Viktor mocks the rival restaurant's chaotic fusion menu, Vika tells Max she has planned a special holiday dinner for his birthday. When she spots the single club ticket from Kostya and Nastya, Max reassures her that his friends will understand.

scenes.title: Строгая оценка  (A Strict Assessment)
scenes.summary: After finishing their meal at the rival restaurant, the hostess asks how they liked the dishes. While his companion praises the food as delicious and nearly as good as theirs, Chef Viktor grudgingly admits that it will do.

scenes.title: Спор о блюде  (Dispute Over the Dish)
scenes.summary: Viktor goes to the rival restaurant and accuses the chef of stealing his new dish.

scenes.title: Ты труп  (You are a corpse)
scenes.summary: Viktor confronts Senya in the kitchen about the stolen recipe.

scenes.title: Сюрприз для всех  (A Surprise for Everyone)
scenes.summary: Vika calls Max, who is waiting outside her apartment with unexpected guests.

scenes.title: Неудачный праздник  (An Unsuccessful Holiday)
scenes.summary: Max brings Nastya and Kostya to Vika's apartment, but everyone is angry at him.

scenes.title: Конец конфликта  (End of the Conflict)
scenes.summary: In the dining room of Claude Monet, the staff and Victoria apologize to Max for ruining his celebration, bringing a peaceful conclusion to their workplace conflicts.

scenes.title: Бокал для шефа  (A Glass for the Chef)
scenes.summary: In the restaurant kitchen, Chef Viktor calls on Nastya to bring him a clean glass so he can join the team in raising a celebratory toast to friendship.

scenes.title: Тайна паспорта  (The Secret of the Passport)
scenes.summary: Examining Max's passport on the kitchen counter, Chef Viktor notices that his birthday is actually in February, revealing that Max told a well-intentioned lie.

scenes.title: Чистый лист  (A Clean Slate)
scenes.summary: Late at night in the kitchen, Max talks with Kostya about the heavy cost of deception and resolves to face the future honestly, starting over with a clean slate.
